items.title: The BSO Meets AI, and Explores the Vitality of Classical Music Today | The Harvard Crimson
items.summary: “SMASH UP” genuinely unsettled Symphony Hall. Iron-sounding trumpets clashed with the mellow strings. The culmination of the movement was an ear-shattering climax — the brass utterly razing any semblance of prior peace. But the following movements, inseparable from their AI participation, were less captivating. Delays between the musicians’ playing and the system’s processing limited their musical conversation — they lacked any shared sound. The music of the orchestra was divided from the odd, [...] From Oct. 22 to 24, the Boston Symphony Orchestra and conductor Kent Nagano performed “already and not yet: A world premiere by Tod Machover.” The headliner was a modern classical work: an onstage musical dialogue between the BSO and a live AI system. Beyond the philosophical implications of the concept, the performance struck at a key nerve of classical music culture — a delicate balancing of tradition and relevance. [...] At the center of Machover’s composition philosophy is his belief that classical music finds a natural extension and innovation in technology. He revealed in an interview with GBH music that the music he hears in his head is often beyond the scope of traditional instruments. Thus, alongside the MIT Media Lab, Machover has developed an audio AI that takes in the playing of the orchestra as input and produces live synthetic sounds that — as Machover puts it — “enhances” the orchestra.

result.actual_text:
**Nguyên hàm của x² là:**

$$\int x^2\,dx = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$$

**Giải thích nhanh:**

Dùng quy tắc lũy thừa: $\int x^n\,dx = \dfrac{x^{n+1}}{n+1} + C$ (với $n \neq -1$).

Áp dụng với $n = 2$:

$$\int x^2\,dx = \frac{x^{2+1}}{2+1} + C = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$$

**Kiểm tra lại bằng đạo hàm:**

$$\left(\frac{x^3}{3}\right)' = \frac{3x^2}{3} = x^2 \quad ✓$$

Vậy kết quả đúng là $\dfrac{x^3}{3} + C$, trong đó $C$ là hằng số tích phân.
